translated: Same here.
Here, enjoy your school life.
See you later.
Being able to say congratulations here is part of Saki-chan's strength.
School starts tomorrow.
I'm glad.
I don't know what the school festival will be like,
but I'm sure it'll be a lot of fun.
Don't make a face like that.
Your fever...
It looks like it's gone down a bit since this morning.
The doctor said if you take your medicine and rest, you'll get better soon.
It's quiet today. Mom and Dad said they couldn't make it either.
Have you heard anything from I-chan and the others?
Saki-chan, are you watching Tsukasa-chan too?
That's right.
It's the group chat from my old class.
Everyone is out fruit picking.
The strawberries look so big and delicious.
Come to think of it, everyone in class sent messages last year saying they wanted to go.
Over there,
the weather is so nice.
But it's raining here.
Am I the only one
who's going to stay like this forever?
